about_the_game:
Welcome to Mobsteria – the ultimate text-based crime strategy game where every decision shapes your criminal legacy.

Start as a nobody on the streets and claw your way to the top of the underworld through pure strategy, cunning, and ruthless ambition. In this deep, text-driven experience, your imagination and tactical thinking are your greatest weapons.

Master the Criminal Arts Execute daring crimes across the world – from quick street hustles to elaborate multi-million dollar heists. Plan grand theft auto operations, choosing your targets wisely as you build an impressive collection of luxury vehicles and establish your reputation as an elite wheelman.

Build Your Criminal Empire Recruit and train a loyal crew of specialised associates, customise them to your play style. Assign them missions, develop their abilities, and watch them evolve from street criminals into your most trusted lieutenants.

Craft Your Way to Power Dive deep into the Workshop's intricate crafting system. Experiment with countless combinations to create powerful tools, weapons, and resources. Unlock rare recipes and master advanced techniques that give you the edge over your rivals.

Shape Your Own Story Experience gripping narrative missions where your choices have lasting consequences. Forge deadly alliances, make dangerous enemies, and carve your own path through the criminal underworld's complex web of loyalty and betrayal.

Dominate the Competition Compete against players worldwide in underground fighting tournaments, high-stakes racing, and strategic crew warfare. Join an established crime family or build your own criminal dynasty from the ground up.

Always Something New With daily challenges, live events, a player-driven economy, and regular content updates, Mobsteria offers endless opportunities for criminal advancement. Accessible from any browser – your empire is always within reach.

Your criminal empire awaits. How ruthless will you become?

content_descriptors.notes: Mobsteria contains mature themes related to organized crime and criminal activities. The game includes references to violence through combat mechanics, criminal acts such as theft, burglary, and armed robbery, and illegal drug trade simulation. Players engage in strategic criminal planning, crew-based conflicts, and underworld power struggles. While all content is text-based without graphic imagery, the game's themes revolve around building and managing criminal enterprises, which may include references to intimidation, extortion, and territorial disputes between crime families. The game does not contain sexual content, depictions of sexual assault, or graphic descriptions of violence.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or similar
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compatible
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Intel or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal compatible graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
